meta.route_used: Route 1+3: page-dimension query run on David's PC with the daily scoreboard's own service-account runner setup (D:\agent\tools\gsc-ga4\, GCP project eurodigital-measurement, key.json beside runner.py, scope webmasters.readonly) via the agent SSH route; dimensions=['page'], rowLimit 25000, same window logic as runner.py (28 days ending yesterday UTC). Route 2 (custom google-search connector gsa.py) not usable: it fails in the VM sandbox with DynamicCredentialError 403 (observed 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-13) and the scoreboard spec marks that OAuth route declined.

reconciliation.note: Clicks reconcile exactly with the property total (25 = 25). Page-level impressions exceed the property total (3,585 vs 2,662): when several pages of the same property appear in one search result, the property counts one impression while each page counts one — documented GSC behaviour, amplified here by 315 similar local pages co-appearing. Group splits below use page-level figures consistently; compare Dec recheck page-level to page-level, never to the property total.

classification_rule.text: Canonicalise each GSC page URL by stripping query string and fragment and any trailing slash. A URL matching /services/<service>/<location> with <location> in the 21 location slugs is a combo: group kept_combo if <service> is one of the 6 keep-matrix services, tail_combo if one of the other 9 catalogue services, combo_outside_matrix if the service slug is not in the current 15-service catalogue at all. Everything else is core. Inventory zero-fill: all 377 URLs from the audit inventory (315 matrix combos + 15 service pages + 21 area pages + 9 site pages + 17 blog posts) are included; inventory URLs with no GSC row carry clicks 0, impressions 0, position null, gsc_row=false.
classification_rule.kept_rule_source: Paper Option 2 keep-matrix: the 4 homepage-featured winter services (src/pages/index.astro featuredServiceSlugs: pressure-washing, gutter-cleaning, moss-algae-treatment, fence-work-minor-repairs) + the 2 driveway services (driveway-grading, gravel-driveway-installation) x 21 areas = 126 combos.
classification_rule.position_aggregation: Group positions are impression-weighted means of page positions (GSC positions do not average arithmetically).

step0_keep_additions.note: Paper step 0: any tail combo earning real impressions or sitting in positions 8-25 joins the keep set regardless of the matrix rule. Judgement on 'real' belongs to the decision step; both lists are provided unfiltered beyond the stated thresholds.
